name: Gratitude & Reflection Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and take several slow breaths to arrive in the present.
Bring to mind three things you're grateful for today, taking a moment to fully picture each one.
For each one, notice how gratitude feels in your body, and let that feeling grow a little each time.
Reflect briefly on one challenge you faced recently, and see if you can find anything to appreciate within it.
Silently offer yourself thanks for showing up for this practice today.
Take a few deep breaths, letting the feeling of gratitude settle in, before opening your eyes.
